biography: Eloi Khouri, a name whispered with anticipation in Brazilian motorsport, hails from the vibrant streets of Sao Paulo. Growing up, the roar of engines was his lullaby, his father being a mechanic for a local karting team. Eloi's passion ignited when, at age 10, his father let him take a few tentative laps in a battered kart. He spun out, of course, but the hook was set. He started racing karts competitively at 12, winning several regional championships before transitioning to Formula Renault at 18. His early career was marked by flashes of brilliance interspersed with rookie errors, but a defining moment came at the Interlagos round of the Formula Renault championship. Despite starting near the back after a qualifying mishap, Eloi carved his way through the field with audacious overtakes, eventually finishing second in a rain-soaked race. This performance caught the eye of Porsche talent scouts, and he was quickly snapped up into their junior program. Now, at 27, Eloi is steadily climbing the GT ranks, proving his mettle in the fiercely competitive world of endurance racing.
drivingStyle: Eloi is a master of defensive driving. He excels at tire management and placing his car in positions that make overtaking incredibly difficult. While not always the fastest qualifier, he shines in race conditions, meticulously plotting his strategy and conserving his equipment. His corner entry is cautious, focusing on a smooth, predictable line, but he’s ruthless in defending his position on corner exit. Eloi thrives under pressure, rarely cracking, and possesses an uncanny ability to anticipate the moves of his rivals.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days. Bellini, known for his aggressive style, often clashes with Eloi's more calculated approach, leading to heated on-track battles.

rivalries.name: Astrid Moreau
rivalries.reason: A strategic rivalry. Moreau, a seasoned veteran, is known for her exceptional racecraft, directly challenging Eloi's tire management and endurance strategies.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka is the young, brash challenger who constantly tries to get in Eloi's head. Eloi, however, remains calm and collected, brushing off Tanaka's taunts and focusing on his own race.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of socks for every race weekend, claiming they bring him luck.
Before each race, Eloi listens to a specific Brazilian samba song to calm his nerves.
He meticulously cleans his driving gloves before and after every session, believing it helps him maintain focus.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about raw speed; it's about outsmarting your opponent, one corner at a time."
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Spa in the GT class with Porsche, after a nail-biting final stint where he held off a hard-charging rival by mere tenths of a second.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Nurburgring 24 Hours due to a sudden downpour, costing his team a victory and severely damaging the car.
